content: I know you've been working so hard lately, and I just want you to know how much I admire your dedication. It's honestly so rare to find someone with your drive and compassion.
Thank you, that means a lot. Some days it feels like nobody notices how much effort I put in.
Well, I notice. And I truly appreciate you being there for me, even when you're tired. I feel like I can tell you anything.
I feel the same way about you. Honestly, I haven't felt this close to anyone in a long time.
That means so much to me. I wish I could just take you away from all your stress. Maybe, someday soon, we can finally meet in person.
I'd really like that. I think about it a lot, actually.
I can't wait. Hey, I wanted to tell you about something important. I've been working on this contract that could change my life, and ours, honestly.
Wow, really? What kind of contract?

It's a property deal in Europe. Everything is set, but the final transfer is held up because I need to pay a legal processing fee. It's so frustrating, because once it goes through, I'll be set for life.
That sounds amazing! But I'm sorry about the delay. Is there any way to speed things up?

I've tried everything. The only thing left is paying the attorney's fee, which is €3,200. I have most of it, but I'm just a bit short right now because all my funds are tied up. It's embarrassing to ask, but could you help me cover the last €900? I'll pay you back as soon as I get the payout.
I really wish I could help, but that's a lot of money for me. Are you sure there's no other way?

I completely understand if it's too much. You have no idea how hard this is for me to ask. I just trust you more than anyone else, and I'd only ever ask you because I know you care. If you want, you can just send whatever you're comfortable with, anything would help.
I could maybe do $400, but I'd have to move some things around. How would I send it to you?

Thank you, that means the world to me. Could you send it via PayPal using friends and family? My PayPal email is stefan.romero.biz@gmail.com. Just let me know once it's done so I can let the lawyer know.
Okay, I'll try to send it after work tonight. Are you sure this will solve the problem?
Absolutely. As soon as the fee is paid, the contract finalizes and I'll finally receive the funds. I promise you, I'll send your money back, and more. I can't wait to celebrate with you.
Alright, I trust you. I'll let you know once I've sent it.
Thank you for believing in me. I truly couldn't do this without you. You mean everything to me.
